annotation.title_clean: Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027 ***I — European Parliament legislative resolution of 17 April 2019
annotation.title_en: Digital Europe programme for the period 2021-2027 ***I — European Parliament legislative resolution of 17 April 2019
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 158
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament's first-reading position on the Digital Europe programme 2021-2027 (€9.2bn), funding high-performance computing, AI, cybersecurity, advanced digital skills and deployment. AI funding is conditioned on ethics checks. Robots, self-driving cars and drones appear only in recitals and as example application areas.
key_provisions_or_claims: Establishes the Digital Europe programme with a €9.194bn envelope for 2021-2027 across five specific objectives.
AI objective requires a human-centric approach, privacy and security by design, and ethics checks, with funding suspendable for non-compliance.
Creates a network of European Digital Innovation Hubs, at least one per Member State.
Recitals cite autonomous robots, self-driving cars and drones as AI application examples; testing sites to cover robotics.
Security rules may exclude third-country-controlled entities from cybersecurity and some AI/HPC actions.
